basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old mechanical engineer living in Seattle, Washington. I've always been fascinated by aviation and aerospace technology, which led to my interest in plane crash investigations and related podcasts. I'm married and enjoy spending my free time exploring local hiking trails with my spouse. I typically log onto Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends. I dislike misinformation and tend to gravitate towards content that is well-researched and factual.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and work in the aerospace sector. My interest in aviation disasters stems from both my professional background and personal curiosity. I often listen to aviation podcasts and read extensively on the topic to stay informed.
